facility_model.strict_rule: Location pages represent collection and recovery service areas, NOT independent physical workshop branches.

component_specific_repairs.scope: Applies to specific components replaced and workmanship undertaken

commercial_and_intensive_use.scope: Taxis, private-hire vehicles, driving-school vehicles, multi-drop delivery vehicles, intensive commercial use

warranty.coverage_scope: Faults arising from workmanship carried out by Gearbox Giants and defects affecting parts supplied and fitted by Gearbox Giants specified on invoice.
warranty.notes: Officially confirmed by business owner: 12 Months or 12,000 miles (whichever occurs first) on full rebuilds / reconditioned units for private vehicles, and 6 Months / 6,000 miles for component repairs or commercial use.

turnaround.diagnostic_estimate: Same day to 24 hours from arrival at central facility
turnaround.notes: Turnaround varies by transmission type, fault complexity, and parts availability. No universal time guarantee permitted.

pricing.notes: Prices are starting benchmarks subject to physical teardown inspection.

dealer_comparison.claim: Reconditioning can save significantly compared to franchised main dealer complete crate replacements
dealer_comparison.notes: Requires verified dataset of like-for-like dealer quotes and internal invoice comparisons.

finance.notes: Subject to lender accreditation, FCA disclosure, and formal finance partner agreement.
